notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(': You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Insurrection, Staging Areas, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice and Han Solo; these count. No starting Interrupt is listed, and several Effects start with none named as the starting Effect.

The post is tagged Light and plays the Light Profit objective; the draft had it as Dark with wrong fuzzy matches (Greedo, Maul's/Galen's Lightsaber, Gift Of The Master, Twi'lek Advisor), all corrected to the posted Light cards.
Total is 59 as published: 7 starting + 24 characters (the post's edit says the character count should be 24, not 25) + 15 interrupts + 4 effects + 3 weapons + 6 locations.
Posted 'Han Solo' (starting) dested the Premiere Han Solo as written; the Characters section also lists Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, which the author's later Profit lists start instead.

Posted 'Tatooine Jabba's Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site; 'Tatooine Cantina' Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'Tatooine Docking Bay' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'Jabba's Palace Antetheatre' the Light Jabba's Palace: Antechamber; 'Dont Get @#$%y' Don't Get Cocky; 'Obi-Wan's Ligtsaber' Obi-Wan's Lightsaber.
No Tatooine-set cards in the list (Tawss Khaa is Special Edition, Elom Jabba's Palace); format Premiere - Reflections II.
This is the author's first Profit list (13 March 2001); his later 'Profit the Prototype' (DeckTech 14712) is a different build (Strike Planning, Insertion Planning, sergeants), not a repost.
